evidence_gaps.what: Complete current engine and gearbox combinations for each trim
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The registry gives the broad choices but not every usable combination, and S(O) Knight automatic feature rows have no current automatic engine combination.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official engine matrix corresponding to PDF page 31, checked against feature rows and footnotes on pages 39 and 41.

evidence_gaps.what: Ground clearance, suspension specification and measured rough-road comfort
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Wheel sizes and exterior photographs cannot establish clearance over speed breakers or how the car feels over bumps.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official specification-sheet dimensions and suspension tables, plus a documented road test identifying the trim, tyres and road surfaces.

evidence_gaps.what: Boot volume, rear legroom, overall length and overall width
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The seat-folding function and luggage photographs do not establish exact capacity, personal seating comfort or parking fit.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official brochure dimensions and luggage-capacity tables, followed by a physical passenger and luggage fit check.

evidence_gaps.what: Crash-test rating and body structure evidence for the exact model and year
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Airbags and assistance features do not establish a crash score or equal crash performance across trims.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Applicable official crash-test report and manufacturer body safety section.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured acceleration, fully loaded diesel climb performance, fuel use, smoothness and noise
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Power and torque specifications and maker descriptions do not prove these driving outcomes or a running-cost saving.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official fuel-economy certification by engine and gearbox, and instrumented road-test results naming the vehicle, load and test conditions.

evidence_gaps.what: Measured seat comfort and seat or cabin cooldown time in hot conditions
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: Airflow through the seat cushions and separate temperature settings do not establish cooling speed, refrigerated seat air or a guaranteed temperature outcome.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Documented seat-ventilation and cabin-climate tests with ambient conditions, starting temperatures and measurement methods.

evidence_gaps.what: Reconciled entry price and current on-road prices for the chosen city and trim
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The source page body states ₹10,90,700 but its structured data states ₹10.79 lakh, and neither supplies the final local total.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Current official price listing and a dated, itemised local dealer quotation identifying the trim and engine.

evidence_gaps.what: Standard warranty, service schedule, local service access, maintenance costs and paid extended-warranty terms
evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: The stated paid petrol extension does not establish standard coverage, package prices or ongoing ownership costs.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Official warranty booklet, service schedule and authorised service locator, a local maintenance estimate, and current extended-warranty coverage and price documents.

evidence_gaps.why_it_matters: No approved fact supports a retained-value promise.
evidence_gaps.suggested_source: Recent documented valuations or completed transactions matched by age, engine, trim, mileage and city.

notes: Make the tour about settling into a car for a warm evening journey that starts in town and can continue farther, with the people and bags it needs to carry. This is an ordinary situation, not a customer biography or a driving-test result. The evidence-backed purchase choice is the engine and gear-changing option, followed by which trim features matter; give the first stop the most weight and the small comforts a short later beat. Keep exactly the seven supplied stop IDs and their order. All seven have evidence, so all remain required; their gaps limit claims rather than erase the stop. F002 permits an optional manufacturer-positioning opening about city use and longer runs; no reputation hook is grounded here. Driving handoff: the petrol engine offers a six-speed manual or IVT; diesel a six-speed manual or six-speed automatic; turbo petrol a seven-speed DCT, listed only for King. King also has other engines, so do not call every King a turbo. The manual-or-automatic USP refers to the available choices across the range, not every engine and trim combination. F004 and F007 are specifications only; F010–F012 remain manufacturer descriptions, not measured acceleration, climbing, mileage or quietness. Modes and paddle shifters have automatic-only rows for S(O), S(O) Knight, SX Premium, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, but the current matrix has no S(O) Knight automatic combination and no SX automatic. Auto hold is unavailable on E, EX, EX(O) and SX; automatic-only on S(O), S(O) Knight and SX Premium; standard on King, King Knight and Lounge Edition, retaining the S(O) Knight combination caveat. Explain holding while stationary without guaranteeing all surfaces. Wheels: R16 on E, EX and EX(O); R17 on S(O), SX and SX Premium; R18 on S(O) Knight, King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. A wheel photo cannot supply its size, ride feel or clearance. Space: the split rear seat, rear vents, rear armrest and front armrest storage are standard; rear recline starts S(O), rear sunshade EX(O), and sliding front armrest operation is only King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. The space USP means changing the balance of passengers and storage, not a specified luggage count. Safety: airbags, stability control, disc brakes, hill-start assistance, tyre-pressure monitoring and rear parking sensors are standard. The airbag USP does not promise identical complete safety equipment or crash performance at every price. Hill-start assistance is an aid and the driver remains responsible. Extra driving assistance is King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; adaptive stop-go is automatic-only in those trims. Surround and blind-spot camera views start SX Premium; that does not give SX Premium the other assistance features. Every assistance explanation retains F034: safe attentive driving is required, effectiveness depends on conditions and intervention is not guaranteed. Cabin: separate front temperature settings start S(O). Both stated screens are 26.03 cm (10.25 inches), starting SX; retain the exact size. Bluelink starts SX with three complimentary years and dependence on adequate power and network. Alexa Home to Car starts SX with separate Alexa hardware; do not change the supported remote engine-start route into a phone-app claim. Phone mirroring starts EX, with a wired-to-wireless adapter required on SX and above and device compatibility required. Both front power seats and driver memory are King, King Knight and Lounge Edition; driver power adjustment separately starts SX Premium. Small comforts: front-seat airflow and Bose sound start SX Premium; panoramic roof starts EX(O), voice operation SX. Airflow passes through seat cushions without a cabin-cooling-time or refrigerated-air promise. Roof voice control has no evidenced distraction or safety benefit. Driver-side welcome lamps start SX; both sides apply to King, King Knight and Lounge Edition. Glove-box cooling starts S(O). Use image descriptions to choose literal evidence, even where a fact has suggested picture links: the engine illustrations are not wheelbase or Alexa pictures; the airbag cutaway is not seat ventilation; the passenger-side dashboard vent is not a rear vent; the front armrest pictures do not show the rear armrest; the phone on a charging pad does not show mirroring or its adapter; rear lamp pictures do not show puddle lamps. The Home-to-Car illustration shows an Alexa air-conditioning request, not a measured remote-start demonstration. Screen readings are illustrative. Do not promote the seatback table, charging pad, USB ports, dashcam or interior material composition from pictures alone, because those product claims have no approved registry facts. Ownership: if used, the entry ex-showroom amount must retain the 19 September 2026 compilation date, the same-page price conflict and the need for a fresh dealer quote; local road tax, registration and insurance are extra. Up to seven years extended warranty is petrol-only and paid separately, with exact package coverage and prices unknown. Fact IDs attached to unknown objections offer partial context only and do not make the full answers supported.
